messages:
maya: FYI staging p95 jumped ~300ms after the 12:10 deploy. Holding prod cutover. suspect kv-cache change.

deploybot: rollout paused at 20% (canary). Auto-fallback threshold 15% p95 breach -> would have triggered. Manual intervention required.

sam: link to dashboard -> https://dash.re/redwood/staging/123 : gap in sequence len distribution at 2-3s

lia: logs show a spike of `KVCacheMiss` on host pool-gpu-21, errors 502 x7

kai: can we pin back to v2.5.2 on the target pool? Prefer manual cutback + quick patch.

ops-lead: +1 to pin. Plan: 1) stop traffic shift 2) pin canary to v2.5.2 3) graceful drain on impacted hosts 4) monitor 10m. Who owns comms?

maya: I'll take customer comms + release note blurb. Sam/Kai, please prepare rollback PR if needed.

sam: preparing PR now. rollback command in staging for reference:
```
kubectl -n redwood rollout undo deploy/redwood-inference --to-revision=42
relabel hosts: `kubectl label node gpu-21 rollback-pinned=true`
```

deploybot: manual pin executed request queued. Use `/deploy pin --env staging --version v2.5.2 --reason "p95 regression"`

lia: running the drain script on pool-gpu-21 now. ETA ~4m :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ops-bot: FYI scheduled change window extended by 15m per ops request.

maya: I'll draft a brief to the incident channel and cc sales for customers on Dedicated.

kai: after pin we should run a quick smoke test (endpoint sanity + sample prompts). I'll run that.

ops-lead: if smoke looks good at +10m we can continue gradual cutover. If not, full revert on prod and postmortem.

maya: thanks all. keeping this thread as main comms. :white_check_mark:
